why: Both proposals share the same sofa, rattan chair, rug, bookcase, table, lamp and throw, and the sofa is tan leather rather than the mustard velvet requested. B's rust-and-blue woven cushions and blue ceramic pot push the palette livelier and tie into the rug, which matches the colorful, lived-in look asked for. A includes the plants but in plastic nursery pots, and B omits the plants entirely, so neither fully meets the request.
